entities.name: Durri
entities.description: A capable Rubblebelt raider and scout of the Zhur-Taa clan of the Gruul, friend to the shaman Kal.

entities.name: Kal
entities.description: A Gruul shaman and Durri's friend who unleashed a powerful fire spell learned from the Izzet.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: The guild of Rubblebelt clans on Ravnica.

entities.name: Zhur-Taa
entities.description: The Gruul clan to which Durri belongs.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The guild whose raiders massacred Cecilee's Selesnyan vernadi.

entities.name: Selesnya
entities.description: The guild whose vernadi were massacred.

entities.name: Cecilee
entities.description: Owner of the Selesnyan vernadi massacred by the Rakdos.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: The infamous leader of the Rakdos killers who escaped.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: Gruul leader who declared war on the Rakdos.

entities.name: Zi
entities.description: A Gruul infant who survived the massacre and was cared for by his uncle Ruzi.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: The guild whose magic Kal learned from watching.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: Region of Ravnica where the Gruul live.

events.summary: Durri tells Kal about the Rakdos massacre of Cecilee's vernadi.
events.quote: One day Durri learned about the Rakdos massacre of Cecilee 's Selesnyan vernadi and shared it with her friend Kal over food.

events.summary: Nikya declares war on the Rakdos, swearing revenge for the perceived killing of the infant Zi.
events.quote: Nikya of the Old Ways declared war on the Rakdos

events.summary: Nikya forbids Durri from the war party, but Kal is included and secretly follows.
events.quote: Nikya forbade Durri to be part of the war party, but Kal was included.

events.summary: The Gruul war party meets the Rakdos raiders in battle.
events.quote: Durri and the rest of the Gruul war party soon ran into the Rakdos raiders, and a battle quickly followed.

events.summary: Kal incinerates a Rakdos flailer, then unleashes a blast that destroys the demons and the rest of the Rakdos before passing out.
events.quote: With a blast of fire, Kal incinerated the grinning flailer.

events.summary: Kal wakes and admits he learned the spell from the Izzet; Durri says it felt like Gruul to her.
events.quote: Nikya told the wounded shaman that Massacre Girl had escaped

relations.note: Raider and scout of the clan.
relations.quote: Rubblebelt raider and scout of the Zhur-Taa clan of the Gruul
The Rakdos killers were led by the infamous Massacre Girl .
